def comps(G,color,conn4=True):
    pts=[(r,c) for r in range(len(G)) for c in range(len(G[0])) if G[r][c]==color]
    nbrs=lambda r,c: [(r+dr,c+dc) for dr,dc in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1))] if conn4 else [(r+dr,c+dc) for dr in(-1,0,1) for dc in(-1,0,1) if (dr,dc)!=(0,0)]
    seen=set();out=[]
    for p in pts:
        if p in seen:continue
        st=[p];comp=[]
        while st:
            q=st.pop()
            if q in seen:continue
            seen.add(q);comp.append(q)
            for n in nbrs(*q):
                if n in pts and n not in seen:st.append(n)
        out.append(sorted(comp))
    return out
